items.t: What Does Lyft (LYFT) Face In The DOJ's $53 Million Disability Lawsuit?
items.sum: Lyft (NasdaqGS:LYFT) has been sued by the U.S. Department of Justice in a $53 million disability discrimination case. The DOJ alleges Lyft failed to provide required accessibility for some passengers with disabilities in its ride services. items.t: Lyft CEO to Participate in Fireside Chat at the 2026 RBC Capital Markets Global Technology, Internet, Media and Telecommunications Conference
items.sum: SAN FRANCISCO, November 10, 2026--Lyft, Inc. (Nasdaq: LYFT) announced today that David Risher, Chief Executive Officer, will participate in a fireside chat at the 2026 RBC Capital Markets Global Technology, Internet, Media and Telecommunications Conference in New York, NY, on Tuesday, November 17, 2026 at 11:20 a.m. ET.

items.t: LYFT Shares Decline 4.2% Since Third-Quarter 2026 Earnings Release
items.sum: Lyft's Q3 2026 revenues rise 8.1% despite an earnings setback, as record rides, higher gross bookings and improving EBITDA highlight operating momentum.

items.t: Canaccord Genuity Maintains Hold on Lyft, Raises Price Target to $17
items.sum: Canaccord Genuity analyst George Gianarikas maintains Lyft (NASDAQ:LYFT) with a Hold and raises the price target from $16 to $17.
